=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:283-293 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `orchestrate_state_v2.py` is missing from the consumer-repo script staging list, so `post_state_comment()` cannot run the V2 pack helper in consumer repositories.
  WHY: the hardcoded staging loop omits the new script; when `python3 scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py pack` is invoked later, consumer repos hit `No such file or directory` and silently fall back to stale V1 persistence.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1047-1093 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `post_state_comment()` returns 0 on every V2 persistence failure path, masking failures as success.
  WHY: pack failure, empty-chunks guard, and chunk-post failure all log errors but return success, so callers proceed as if state was persisted and later reread stale state.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1098-1113 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `_post_state_comment_v2_chunk()` discards all GitHub API output by redirecting stdout and stderr to `/dev/null`.
  WHY: chunk-post failures lose HTTP status, response body, and retry diagnostics, making persistent 422/403/429/network issues opaque.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:582-594 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `CONFLICT_RESOLVER_PER_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_SECS` accepts any positive integer with no upper bound, so an oversized override can consume the whole 60-minute step budget.
  WHY: the regex validation only enforces positivity; if the per-attempt timeout matches or exceeds the step timeout, the retry loop never reaches later attempts.
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:199 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `comments_path.read_text()` relies on the locale default encoding instead of UTF-8.
  WHY: on a non-UTF-8 runner locale, decoding GitHub's UTF-8 JSON can raise `UnicodeDecodeError`, causing V2 extraction to fail and the poller to fall back to stale V1 state.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:341-344 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `_is_state_comment()` uses substring containment to detect state markers.
  WHY: a test fixture that mentions `ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_V1` or `ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_V2` in prose can be misclassified as a state comment and filtered out of `tracking_comments`.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:119-158 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_substring_overlap_drops()` drops `must_not_contain` patterns when their escaped regex source is a literal substring of a `must_contain` pattern on the same file.
  WHY: that can suppress a real forbidden-pattern check when the shorter pattern is not merely the intended line-extension case; one reviewer argued the current behavior is intentional.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1144-1184 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: the V2 extract path accepts `candidate_state` after `is_valid_orchestrator_state_json` without an independent manifest/size re-check.
  WHY: a malformed or torn V2 chain that still parses as JSON could be ingested as poller state instead of being rejected.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:284 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `orchestrate_state_v2.py` is omitted from the `_fetched_scripts` staging loop.
  WHY: consumer repos that execute this workflow staging step will not have `scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py` on disk at runtime, so `python3 scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py pack` fails and V2 persistence is skipped.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1069, 1076, 1086 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `post_state_comment` returns 0 on all three V2 persistence failure paths.
  WHY: the pack failure branch, the empty-chunks guard, and the chunk-post failure branch all signal success to the caller despite logging `::error::` messages.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1106-1108 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_post_state_comment_v2_chunk` redirects both stdout and stderr of the `gh_retry gh api` POST call to `/dev/null`.
  WHY: when chunk posting fails, all API diagnostics are discarded, so operators cannot distinguish transient rate limits from persistent validation or auth failures.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:588 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `CONFLICT_RESOLVER_PER_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_SECS` is validated only as a positive integer with no upper bound.
  WHY: an override like 3600 can consume the entire step budget before the retry loop reaches attempts 2 and 3.
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:199 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `comments_path.read_text()` is called without an explicit `encoding="utf-8"` parameter.
  WHY: on a runner with a non-UTF-8 default locale, decoding the UTF-8 JSON payload can raise `UnicodeDecodeError` and force a fallback to stale V1 state.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:341-344 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `_is_state_comment(body)` classifies a comment as a state comment whenever the body contains `ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_V1` or `ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_V2`.
  WHY: a fixture that mentions those markers in prose can be filtered out of `tracking_comments`, causing spurious test failures.
